user_actions: Export one county-year from https://analytics.mdsp.org/t/Public/views/PublicCrash2/PublicCrash (e.g. Baltimore City, 1/1/2024-12/31/2024): click the map once, Download > Data, then for each tab (Reports, Contributing Circumstances, Occupants, NonMotorists, Vehicles) Show Fields > (All) > Download. Put the five files in ~/.hermes/cache/scratch/states/md/export/. A reader is built against them.
Ask MSP (Central Records / the dashboard owner) or MDOT SHA Office of Traffic & Safety whether Maryland's statewide crash data is available as a bulk file or API, and whether a paid tool may use it
Decide: should Montgomery County's open, public-domain ACRS feed (road + cross street + GPS, ~10k crashes a year) be offered as a Maryland county pack until the statewide data is reachable?
